behaviors: Durable push and PR intents precede external writes; restart adopts a matching PR after a lost create response without resending an inconclusive request.
Repository UUID preflight precedes Git writes. Explicit remote/ref leases reject competing branches and protected targets. Source/base drift blocks PR creation and readiness.
Only the active coordinator may publish a clean, changed, independently reviewed current candidate. PR content includes accepted criteria and actual local evidence identities.
Required status keys, PR identity, head, base, latest matching pipeline and required step results all constrain readiness. Optional SKIPPED remains distinct; required SKIPPED blocks.
A delivery reporter can queue the verified PR link and candidate evidence in Jira. Pausing during credential lookup prevents the later provider write.
Server-owned Git commands retain process ownership and have time/output bounds. Credentials remain server-side. There is no merge operation.
regressionsFound: A failing fixture proved source drift after confirmed push could still create a PR. The current guard passes the same test.
The browser test originally asserted while asynchronous reconciliation was still pending. It now waits for the actual mutation response before checking presentation.
boundaries: Provider mutation tests use loopback HTTP fixtures and a local bare Git remote. No live Jira/Bitbucket mutation or Conductor source change occurred.
The PR browser/service fixture uses explicitly labeled controller evidence fixtures. Full real OMP/Git/container delivery integration remains M4.4.
The bkt CLI can read live Bitbucket, but direct server Keychain access timed out during the read-only probe. Production OAuth access is not yet verified; M5 must resolve it.
The current publication is immutable per run. Operator-selected review continuation and updated publication revisions remain M6.3.
Unknown writes and permission rejections stay visible for explicit recovery; no blind retries or automatic merge are offered.

transportDecision.selection: Fixed-origin direct Bitbucket REST client, with no automatic mutation retries.
transportDecision.reason: Source inspection of bkt 0.26.6 found network/5xx retries without an HTTP-method restriction, which cannot satisfy the lost-create-response contract. bkt is used only for read-only OAuth refresh.
